items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: I was brought up on Jimmy Lunceford.

ctx.x: This is for the archives at Hamilton College. George, I’ve often wondered how an Englishman like you comes to the point you are with the music, and the legacy and the history of the music, and to understand it so well, and to go to innovations of your own from where you came from, relating to this music. How did you get to this music I want to know? The jazz, that good sound that you give us all over.
I was brought up on Jimmy Lunceford.
